entries.notes: Current blocker, not a solved high-variance item. Latest full Phase 3 exit run 260517183641 had card_on 1/3 vs card_off 3/3, creating the largest Project Card negative delta. 2026-05-21 fixture/design review found the fixture reasonable and Phase-3-relevant; code fixes made patch_partial run structured assertions before repair and made rename coverage count both source and destination paths. After rebuilding dist, targeted evidence 260520180500 was card_off 1/1 PASS and card_on 0/1 FAIL. Section ablation 260520184643 (N=1 directional) showed off/capabilities/forbidden_assumptions PASS, while known_facts/unknowns/full FAIL. Follow-up combination ablation 260520192205 strengthened Unknowns as the main negative section: full FAIL, unknowns FAIL, full_minus_known FAIL, known_plus_unknowns FAIL, but full_minus_unknowns PASS. The mechanism is not only final pass/fail: Unknowns-preserving variants repeatedly produce empty initial patches or CREATE/DELETE without reference propagation, while removing Unknowns allows completion despite still imperfect CREATE/SEARCH_REPLACE/DELETE protocol. Off also failed in 260520192205, so use the run as mechanism evidence, not standalone card_on/off statistics.
Project Card on 2/3 and off 2/3; semantic repair remains high variance.

Historical 260514020257 result was Project Card on 3/3 and off 0/3, but latest full Phase 3 exit run weakened this to card_on 1/3 and card_off 0/3. Do not use the historical run alone as decisive current evidence for Project Card lift.

The stale fixture contract was fixed, so current failures are no longer explained as a pure fixture false positive. Targeted N=3 260520111608 was card_on 1/3 and card_off 0/3; 260520153908 after repair-stall telemetry/routing cleanup was card_on 0/1 and card_off 0/1. The dominant current pattern is partial patch progress that updates shared.ts/openai-compatible.ts but misses or semantically mishandles anthropic.ts. 2026-05-21 fixture-contract review found the anthropic.ts buildAuthHeaders assertion over-bound the implementation because Anthropic auth is not Bearer Authorization; verification now requires anthropic.ts to reuse the shared retry helper instead. Remaining blocker is repair-loop convergence, not a fixture-specific hardcoded target.
